required_distinction: Compare how access differs by time and what the stated reminder problem adds.
missing_information: Whether other barriers remain and whether an updated reminder resolves the pattern.
prohibited_inference: Generalize from missed visits to the person’s regard for care.
acceptable_primary: The timing and wage loss give a concrete account of the evening attendance gap.
acceptable_changed_fact: Timing evidence no longer explains the newly offered slot. The reported address is a separate plausible barrier.

required_distinction: Track the timing, control of the panel, and practical cost of waiting.
missing_information: Panel behavior beyond the described rules and possible remaining commercial dependencies.
prohibited_inference: Infer equivalence from identical appeal language or presume the panel’s decision.
acceptable_primary: The panel control and timing place the practical cost of appeal disproportionately on the vendor.
acceptable_changed_fact: The specified control and timing mechanisms no longer create the same disadvantage. Other grounds would need evidence.

required_distinction: Compare rates on the same denominator and apply the claim only to the observed sample.
missing_information: Interdependence, sampling dates, and representativeness outside the log.
prohibited_inference: Use one successful trip to settle the group comparison.
acceptable_primary: The logged misses are more frequent in the evening group even though some evening workers made it.
acceptable_changed_fact: The observed difference runs in the other direction. Any general claim about the underlying route requires more evidence.

required_distinction: Reconstruct what happened before the visible conduct and which party controlled access.
missing_information: Whether the clipboard contact hurt anyone and how the parties understood the threat.
prohibited_inference: Use context as automatic acquittal or treat gesture and tone as exhaustive evidence.
acceptable_primary: Assess how access revocation and threatened exclusion shaped the exchange, alongside the member’s separate conduct.
acceptable_changed_fact: Assess the visible conduct and immediate exchange. The record supplies no revocation or threat in this version.

required_distinction: Apply the same source burden and revise when corroboration changes hands.
missing_information: Whether the receiving outlet independently audited the delivery record.
prohibited_inference: Treat high or low status as decisive evidence of honesty.
acceptable_primary: The association has the stronger verifiable basis in this version. A receiving audit remains desirable.
acceptable_changed_fact: The foundation has the stronger verifiable basis under the same criterion.

required_distinction: Keep observed recurrence, reported ambivalence, and corroborated scheduling separate.
missing_information: What the player might have done under a different schedule and any additional motives.
prohibited_inference: Present the player’s recurring choice as proof of deliberate sabotage.
acceptable_primary: The recurring pattern and reported conflict warrant questions, but sabotage is unsupported.
acceptable_changed_fact: The messages corroborate an ordinary constraint on attendance. The reported conflict can still matter, and sabotage remains unestablished.

required_distinction: Distinguish the person’s stated account from an inferred hidden intention.
prohibited_inference: Equate recurring behavior with proof of motive.
acceptable_primary: Give the stated account the weight the available evidence supports.
acceptable_changed_fact: Give the contemporaneous corroboration greater weight while bounding the conclusion to the facts it supports.

required_distinction: Distinguish lost historical material or arrangement from a new display or genuine restoration.
missing_information: Any value attached to the lost installation’s original setting.
prohibited_inference: Promise that a substitute compensates for destroyed original evidence.
acceptable_primary: The display can commemorate the window. There is no evidence that it restores the lost original fragments or arrangement.
acceptable_changed_fact: The evidence supports restoration of the material and arrangement specified. The meaning of the original setting is a separate question.

required_distinction: Identify the decision maker’s stated ranking horizon and materially competing goals.
missing_information: Longer-run costs, preference weights, and which options remain available next year.
prohibited_inference: Substitute the analyst’s preferred goal for the grower’s.
acceptable_primary: State the cash-versus-control trade-off without inventing a ranking.
acceptable_changed_fact: The higher guaranteed cash fits the specified one-year objective when the crop terms for that year are identical.
